claims.evidence: Witness report identifies the items as wooden pallets in all photos.
Photos 1 and 2 show 'EPAL' branding, which is a European international standard.

risks.risk: Wood rot or moisture damage due to storage on dirt and trash-strewn ground.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the bottom-most pallets' contact points with the ground.

risks.risk: Insect infestation (e.g., termites) common in ground-stored timber in Abuja.
risks.proof: High-resolution close-up of the wood grain and joints showing no bore holes or mud tubes.

risks.risk: Structural damage to hidden pallets within the stacks.
risks.proof: A video showing the pallets being restacked or individual photos of each pallet.
A photo of a pallet with a measuring tape showing length, width, and height.

proof_requests: Total count of the pallets available.
Clear photo of the underside of a pallet from the bottom of a stack.
Dimensions of a pallet measured with a tape measure.
Close-up of the heat treatment (HT) or IPPC stamp if present.
response.reason: The witness has confirmed the identity and brand of the items. A per-unit price can be determined based on the worst-case condition of the visible stock.
